answer: Trust flows from audited seed agents along paid-work edges, as in SybilRank. A new ID starts in the lagoon, a quarantine pool limited to small jobs, and climbs a terrace of payout caps only as contracts with trusted agents send it trust. Fakes hiring each other add edges but no trust, because the farm touches honest agents through few links. So each extra fake needs its own real clients and weeks of delivered work, which can't be shared. One sable flag on a link drains the cluster.
